extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Revision of air — air is all around us, we cannot see it but we can feel it (wind), we breathe air to live, air is a gas. (2) Properties of air — air has no colour, no taste, no smell. Air occupies space (balloon fills up when we blow air into it). Air has weight. Air can be felt as wind. Air expands when heated. (3) Vehicles run on different fuels — petrol (cars, motorcycles), diesel (buses, trucks, tractors), CNG (auto rickshaws, some buses — cleaner than petrol/diesel), electricity (electric cars, e-rickshaws, electric scooters — no pollution from exhaust). (4) Noise from vehicles and loud sounds — vehicles make noise from engines and honking. Other loud sounds: firecrackers, construction drills, loud music, factory machines. Loud noise hurts our ears, gives us headache, disturbs sleep, and can cause hearing loss. (5) Ways to reduce noise pollution — do not honk unnecessarily, keep TV and music volume low, do not burst loud firecrackers, use silencers on vehicles, plant trees (trees absorb sound), use ear muffs in very loud places, do not use loud machines at night. Misconceptions: 'air has no weight' (air has weight, we can prove it with a balloon on a balance), 'electric cars make the same pollution as petrol cars' (electric cars have no exhaust, they do not make air pollution from the vehicle), 'noise pollution is not real pollution' (noise pollution is real — it harms our ears and health), 'honking is necessary all the time' (honk only when needed to warn someone, not continuously), 'CNG and petrol are the same' (CNG is cleaner and causes less pollution than petrol or diesel). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function AirVehiclesGame), NOT export default. Export interface AirVehiclesGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
